A code execution issue in the Java integration in Apache OpenOffice v4.1.16 and earlier allows a crafted untrusted document to trigger executing arbitrary (even remote) code when opened by the user.



This issue is expected to be fixed in version 4.1.17, which is in the release candidate phase.



Until then, users can mitigate this issue by disabling Java runtime integration in the Preferences dialog. This prevents the attack. If this is not possible, or as an extra precaution, you can avoid opening open untrusted files entirely. Once 4.1.17 is released, upgrade to that version to fix the issue.

A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Drug Recommendation System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file Admin/add_drug.php. Performing a manipulation results in cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

A vulnerability was determined in chillzhuang SpringBlade up to 5.0.1. This affects an unknown function of the file blade-service/blade-system/src/main/java/org/springblade/system/controller/RoleController.java of the component User Detail Endpoint. This manipulation of the argument ID causes improper authorization. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw has been found in PickMall Lilishop up to 4.2.4. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /buyer/passport/member/bindMobile of the component Mobile Binding. This manipulation of the argument Username causes improper authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in sssd. A local attacker can trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted Pluggable Authentication Module (PAM) request when passkey authentication is enabled. Due to a missing state validation check in passkey Kerberos handling, the PAM responder dereferences an uninitialized pointer and crashes. This failure disrupts authentication services on the host.

A flaw was found in SSSD. A local user can cause a denial of service (DoS) by disrupting system authentication services. When handling Generic Security Services Application Programming Interface (GSSAPI) authentication in the Pluggable Authentication Module (PAM) responder, cached connection state is freed upon completion without clearing the reference pointer. An attacker can exploit this by sending an additional request over the same connection, causing the service to access invalid memory and unexpectedly terminate.

A weakness has been identified in girishsaraf Online-Appointment-Booking-System up to f427b4757128ca253d33d0cc4e87bbb9c999a4d5. The affected element is an unknown function of the file book.php of the component Booking Handler. This manipulation of the argument Doctor/appointment causes sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This product adopts a rolling release strategy to maintain continuous delivery. Therefore, version details for affected or updated releases cannot be specified. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in SSSD. An issue in the Kerberos Credential Manager (KCM) responder allows a local user to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by maintaining a persistent connection and repeatedly storing and destroying credentials. Because the service fails to release cached objects from memory when credentials are removed, memory consumption grows continuously, ultimately exhausting available memory and rendering the service unresponsive.

Dbit WIFI4 N300 1.0.0 devices allow the management interface to be crashed via a request (from the local Wi-Fi network) that lacks a /api/login username or password field. This occurs because of an error in a JSON parser.

Joplin is an open source note-taking and to-do application that organises notes and lists into notebooks. Prior to Joplin Server 3.7.2, packages/server/src/models/TokenModel.ts stores CSRF, account-confirmation, email-change, and password-reset tokens without a purpose, and packages/server/src/models/UserModel.ts allows UserModel.resetPassword to accept any token returned by TokenModel.userFromToken. An attacker who obtains a victim's CSRF or confirmation token through a separate disclosure channel can submit it to the public password-reset endpoint, replace the victim's password, and cause the existing sessions and API applications to be deleted. This issue is fixed in Joplin Server 3.7.2.

Twenty is an open-source CRM (customer relationship management) platform. From 1.20.10 until 2.7.0, the /metadata GraphQL connectedAccounts query returned connectionParameters from ConnectedAccountDTO for every connected account in a workspace, including plaintext IMAP, SMTP, and CalDAV passwords, because the field was not hidden and the lookup did not enforce the calling user's identity or account visibility. A normal workspace member could obtain other members' external-service credentials and use them to access mail or calendars and potentially reset third-party accounts. Google and Microsoft OAuth-only workspaces were not affected. This issue is fixed in version 2.7.0.

vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. From 0.24.0 until 0.30.0, the Qwen2VLVideoBackend and Qwen3VLVideoBackend classes accept request-level values for the media_io_kwargs.video.max_frames and media_io_kwargs.video.fps fields without enforcing server-side ceilings. An unauthenticated caller can submit these values to the /tokenize endpoint, causing the sampler to decode every frame selected from attacker-controlled video input, consume disproportionate frontend memory, and potentially terminate the API process before scheduling or admission control. The Rust frontend is not affected because it rejects the media_io_kwargs field. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.0.

vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.30.0, the /inference/v1/generate endpoint in the disaggregated scale-out path accepts caller-supplied tensors in the features.kwargs_data field, cache identifiers in the features.mm_hashes field, ranges in the features.mm_placeholders field, and wire-selected multimodal field processors without rebinding them to the active model renderer contract. Forged grid geometry, field types, or non-positive placeholder lengths can terminate the shared EngineCore; when an attacker knows or can induce a victim's content hash, forged cache hashes can poison or retrieve cross-request encoder-cache state; and dropped sparse placeholder masks can alter replayed transport semantics. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.0.

A vulnerability was found in girishsaraf Online-Appointment-Booking-System up to f427b4757128ca253d33d0cc4e87bbb9c999a4d5. This affects the function mysqli_query of the file Admin/mlogin.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument uname/pass results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. This product uses a rolling release model to deliver continuous updates. As a result, specific version information for affected or updated releases is not available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats and providing integrations with the generative AI ecosystem. From 2.0.0 until 2.131.0, the HTML, JATS, OpenDocument spreadsheet, and BoxNote backends, including docling/backend/html_backend.py, docling/backend/jats_backend.py, and docling/backend/boxnote_backend.py, accept the rowspan and colspan attribute values without an upper bound and execute loops or allocate a table grid proportional to the declared span. A very small document can therefore cause sustained CPU use or multi-gigabyte memory allocation, and the document_timeout setting does not interrupt the single backend conversion call. Export through the TableData.grid property can further materialize the oversized grid. This issue is fixed in 2.131.0.

Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats and providing integrations with the generative AI ecosystem. From 2.91.0 until 2.132.0, validate_url_safety in docling/backend/utils/image_resource_loader.py validates a hostname with a single IPv4 lookup and then allows the HTTP client to resolve and parse the original URL again, permitting DNS rebinding, mixed public and internal address records, and backslash authority parser disagreement to reach internal services. HTMLBackendOptions(render_page=True) also allows HTTP and HTTPS browser requests without validating their resolved destination. Exploitation requires remote fetching to be enabled, and response content is exposed only when it is decoded as an image or passively rendered in a page screenshot. This issue is fixed in 2.132.0.

Langflow is a tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. From 1.6.8 until 1.9.1, Langflow authenticated access to the project identifier in a project-scoped MCP connection but did not authorize the resource URI supplied to resources/read. read_resource forwarded the attacker-controlled URI to handle_read_resource, which parsed a flow_id and filename and called storage_service.get_file without verifying that the flow belonged to the authenticated user or current project. A user with access to any project-scoped MCP endpoint could therefore request another user's flow-backed file, while global handle_list_resources and handle_list_tools behavior could disclose flow and file identifiers that made targeting easier. The vulnerability disclosed uploaded documents, structured data, prompts, and other private flow artifacts across tenants but did not modify victim files or stored flows. This issue is fixed in version 1.9.1.

A flaw was found in Quay. When handling build trigger requests, the application incorrectly exposes trigger configuration details containing repository write tokens to global read-only administrative users. An authenticated user with read-only privileges can exploit this flaw by querying the build trigger API to retrieve these delegate tokens. This issue allows a restricted user to bypass read-only limitations and push arbitrary container images to private repositories, leading to privilege escalation.

Penpot is an open-source design and prototyping platform. Prior to 2.18.0, authenticated users with file-edit permission can upload SVG media whose scripts, event-handler attributes, and foreignObject elements are stored without sanitization and served as image/svg+xml from the Penpot origin. A victim who navigates to the asset URL executes attacker-controlled JavaScript in that origin, allowing requests and data access with the victim's Penpot session authority. This issue is fixed in version 2.18.0.

Penpot is an open-source design and prototyping platform. Prior to 2.18.0, app.util.ssrf/blocked-address? relies on Java InetAddress predicates that do not classify NAT64, 6to4, or Teredo addresses and applies additional CIDR checks only to IPv4 values. Exploitation requires routing through a NAT64 gateway or an attacker-controlled DNS AAAA record; cloud environments with NAT64 gateways are directly exploitable. A user controlling a media import URL, or an administrator controlling a webhook URL, can then supply an IPv6 transition address that embeds a cloud-metadata, loopback, link-local, or private IPv4 target and bypasses the intended SSRF restrictions. Media import can disclose response bodies, while webhook delivery can expose response status as a network-probing side channel. This issue is fixed in version 2.18.0.

Ghost is a Node.js content management system. From 6.14.0 until 6.27.0, an input validation issue may have allowed staff users to access local files outside the intended data storage directories on the server. This issue is fixed in version 6.27.0.

NXP MQX Classic before 5.0 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the RTCS UDP recvfrom() implementation. Improper enforcement of the application-supplied receive buffer length may allow a crafted UDP packet to overflow the destination buffer, resulting in memory corruption, or denial of service.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated list of 417 vulnerabilities reveals a pervasive threat environment characterized by widespread remote code execution and privilege escalation risks, particularly within Microsoft ecosystems and critical network infrastructure. Desktop operating systems, cloud platforms, and web applications suffer from numerous heap-based buffer overflows, use-after-free conditions, and authentication bypasses that compromise Windows components, Azure services, Office suites, and SQL Server, while network devices face similar exploitation vectors in DHCP, DNS, and routing protocols. Additional high-severity findings include critical deserialization flaws in databases, injection attacks in web frameworks like Spring, and actively exploited vulnerabilities in identity management and update mechanisms, posing immediate risks to endpoint integrity, data confidentiality, and cloud tenant isolation.

items.reason_zh: 该 Windows Deployment Services 释放后使用漏洞 CVSS 评分为 9.8，允许未经授权的网络代码执行，严重影响企业部署工作流。

items.reason_en: The LSASS heap-based buffer overflow allows network-based code execution, directly threatening credential harvesting and lateral movement capabilities on compromised hosts.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，直接威胁受损主机上的凭据收集和横向移动能力。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Remote Desktop Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, directly threatening remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中的堆溢出漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，直接威胁远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, impacting a widely deployed consumer and enterprise browser.

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Win32k.sys graphics driver allows local privilege escalation, frequently exploited in post-exploitation chains to gain SYSTEM access.
items.reason_zh: Win32k.sys 图形驱动程序的堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，常被用于后续利用链中以获取 SYSTEM 权限。

items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的堆溢出漏洞通过破坏核心内存结构实现本地权限提升，为完全控制系统提供了基础攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Dell System Update allows local attackers to escalate privileges, compromising endpoint integrity and enabling unauthorized system modifications.
items.reason_zh: Dell System Update 中的权限分配错误漏洞允许本地攻击者提升权限，破坏终端完整性并启用未经授权的系统修改。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution via crafted Markdown notes exploits insufficient sanitization of iframe attributes, bypassing DOMPurify and affecting desktop note-taking application users.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的 Markdown 笔记实现远程代码执行，利用了 iframe 属性过滤不足的缺陷，绕过 DOMPurify 防护，影响桌面笔记应用用户。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled search path in TightVNC Server allows local authenticated users to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by loading malicious DLLs.
items.reason_zh: TightVNC Server 中的不受控搜索路径漏洞允许本地已认证用户通过加载恶意 DLL 以 SYSTEM 权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in GIMP's DDS image loader can be triggered by crafted files, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 DDS 图像加载器中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的文件触发，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_zh: TightVNC Viewer 的 ZRLE 解码器中存在越界读取漏洞，允许恶意服务器泄露堆内存内容并导致客户端崩溃。

items.reason_en: Lack of integrity checks in the HPE ClearPass OnGuard agent permits unauthenticated remote code execution with elevated privileges on Linux workstations and servers.
items.reason_zh: HPE ClearPass OnGuard 代理缺乏完整性检查，允许在未认证的情况下以高权限在 Linux 工作站和服务器上执行远程代码。

items.reason_zh: HPE ClearPass 客户端代理缺失完整性校验，允许未认证攻击者在受管网络终端注入并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow vulnerabilities in HPE AOS-S management interfaces enable unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve full system compromise without prior authentication.
items.reason_zh: HPE AOS-S 管理接口存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，使未认证远程攻击者能够在无需预先认证的情况下完全接管系统。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Azure Data Manager for Energy enables remote code execution, directly threatening energy grid monitoring and operational technology systems.
items.reason_zh: Azure Data Manager for Energy 中存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁电网监控与运营技术系统。

items.reason_en: Script injection vulnerability in Exchange OWA facilitates phishing campaigns and credential harvesting through manipulated web requests.
items.reason_zh: Exchange OWA 中的脚本注入漏洞可通过篡改 Web 请求便利网络钓鱼活动与凭据收集。

items.reason_en: Reflected file download bypass in Spring Framework allows attackers to deliver malicious payloads disguised as legitimate files via manipulated headers.
items.reason_zh: Spring Framework 中的反射文件下载绕过漏洞允许攻击者通过篡改请求头，将恶意载荷伪装成合法文件进行投递。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in IBM Security Verify Access web UI enables unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious JavaScript and alter application functionality.
items.reason_zh: IBM Security Verify Access Web UI 存在跨站脚本漏洞，使未认证攻击者能够注入恶意 JavaScript 代码并篡改应用程序功能。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in NetBoard CRM's recovery endpoint allows attackers to extract sensitive data and potentially compromise backend systems.
items.reason_zh: NetBoard CRM 的恢复端点存在盲 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者提取敏感数据并可能接管后端系统。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication and OS command injection in Dromara Skyeye endpoints allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary scripts and gain full server control.
items.reason_zh: Dromara Skyeye 端点缺失身份验证且存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者执行任意脚本并获取服务器完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), this vulnerability allows local privilege escalation to root on Zammad instances due to unsafe service account handling.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已被实际利用（列入 CISA KEV），由于服务账户处理不当，允许在 Zammad 实例中将本地权限提升至 root。

items.reason_en: Also listed in CISA KEV, this session hijacking flaw leads to remote code execution as the zammad user, demonstrating real-world attack viability.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞同样列入 CISA KEV，此会话劫持缺陷可导致以 zammad 用户身份执行远程代码，证实了其在现实攻击中的可行性。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL for Node.js compromises modern web application identity flows, enabling session hijacking and spoofing.
items.reason_zh: MSAL for Node.js 通过抓包重放绕过身份验证，破坏现代 Web 应用的身份验证流程，导致会话劫持与伪造。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions against web hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在资源耗尽漏洞，允许未认证攻击者针对 Web 托管环境触发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network, undermining user trust and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在跨站脚本漏洞，允许攻击者在网络上实施欺骗攻击，破坏用户信任与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing, facilitating credential theft or drive-by download attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗，便于攻击者窃取凭证或发起驱动式下载攻击。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in .NET allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, impacting web application file system security.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的文件名或路径外部控制漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，影响 Web 应用程序的文件系统安全。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Data Quality enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, allowing attackers to pivot to internal network resources.
items.reason_zh: Data Quality 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，使攻击者能够横向移动到内部网络资源。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) enables unauthenticated remote code execution, representing a high-severity browser exploitation vector targeting web users globally.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge (基于 Chromium) 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致无需认证的远程代码执行，这是一种针对全球 Web 用户的高危浏览器利用向量。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Edge allows unauthorized bypass of browser security features, facilitating advanced persistent threats, sandbox escapes, and drive-by download attacks.
items.reason_zh: Edge 中的类型混淆漏洞可绕过浏览器安全特性，便于实施高级持续性威胁、沙箱逃逸及驱动式下载攻击。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in Edge enables remote code execution, exposing users to malicious payload delivery via crafted web content and extensions.
items.reason_zh: Edge 中的文件名或路径外部控制漏洞可导致远程代码执行，使用户面临通过构造的 Web 内容和扩展程序投递恶意载荷的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Edge permits remote code execution, highlighting critical sanitization gaps in modern web rendering engines that require immediate mitigation.
items.reason_zh: Edge 中的输入验证不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了现代 Web 渲染引擎中亟需修复的关键过滤缺陷。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution via malicious web content, directly targeting browser users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行，直接危及浏览器用户。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft Edge allows remote code execution, highlighting persistent risks in Chromium-based browser engines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，凸显了基于 Chromium 的浏览器引擎中持续存在的风险。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows attackers to bypass security features remotely, threatening developer toolchains and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 和 Visual Studio 中的注入漏洞允许攻击者远程绕过安全特性，威胁开发者工具链及 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, this weak authentication flaw in SharePoint allows complete security feature bypass over the network.
items.reason_zh: 根据 CISA KEV 记录，SharePoint 中的此弱认证漏洞已在野外被积极利用，允许攻击者通过网络完全绕过安全特性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables attackers to perform spoofing and potentially steal credentials or execute malicious scripts in user browsers.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可使攻击者实施欺骗，并可能窃取凭证或在用户浏览器中执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Another critical XSS vulnerability in SharePoint web page generation facilitates targeted phishing and session hijacking attacks.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 网页生成过程中的另一项关键 XSS 漏洞便于实施定向钓鱼与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap overflow in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution, targeting a widely deployed web browser.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，该漏洞针对一款广泛部署的 Web 浏览器。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 remote code execution in Outlook facilitates phishing-driven initial access attacks, making it a high-value target for threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的远程代码执行漏洞便于实施钓鱼驱动的初始访问攻击，使其成为威胁行为体的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution, potentially leading to complete site takeover and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的访问控制不当漏洞可导致远程代码执行，可能引发站点被完全接管及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Visual Studio Code enables attackers to bypass security restrictions and access restricted files over the network.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者绕过安全限制，并通过网络访问受限文件。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network spoofing and phishing. High severity due to widespread enterprise email dependency and direct user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现网络欺骗与钓鱼攻击。由于企业邮件系统依赖度高且涉及直接用户交互，该漏洞危害等级较高。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Exchange Server allows network privilege escalation. Bypasses security controls on internet-facing mail servers, enabling unauthorized administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的缺失授权漏洞可导致网络权限提升。该漏洞绕过了面向互联网邮件服务器的安全控制，使攻击者能够获得未授权的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: External control of file name/path in Microsoft Exchange Server enables network code execution. Path traversal flaws in web services frequently lead to full server takeover.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的文件名/路径外部控制漏洞可导致网络代码执行。Web 服务中的路径遍历缺陷通常会导致服务器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network privilege escalation. Compromises collaborative document management platforms and internal web portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞可导致网络权限提升，危及协同文档管理平台及内部 Web 门户。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Federation Services causes network DoS. Disrupts critical SSO and identity federation services required for modern access management.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出可导致网络拒绝服务（DoS），中断现代访问管理所必需的关键单点登录（SSO）与身份联合服务。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, exposing sensitive analytics, notebooks, and data pipeline configurations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric 中的路径遍历漏洞允许无需认证的权限提升，导致敏感分析数据、笔记本及数据流水线配置暴露。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI enables session hijacking and spoofing attacks against business intelligence users and dashboard consumers.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中的跨站脚本漏洞可对商业智能用户及仪表板使用者实施会话劫持与欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core facilitates remote denial-of-service attacks against web applications and API endpoints.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中缺乏节流机制的资源分配漏洞便于对 Web 应用程序及 API 端点发起远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous methods in Azure Confidential Ledger enable remote code execution, compromising secure ledger operations and audit trails.
items.reason_zh: Azure Confidential Ledger 中暴露的危险方法可导致远程代码执行，危及安全账本操作与审计轨迹。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows unauthenticated network RCE. Already confirmed exploited in the wild, making immediate patching critical.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可导致无需认证的网络远程代码执行。该漏洞已确认在野外被利用，因此紧急修补至关重要。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables network spoofing, carrying high impact for enterprise web portals and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可实现网络欺骗，对企业 Web 门户及协作平台造成严重影响。

items.reason_en: Critical cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Exchange Server enables attackers to perform spoofing and phishing campaigns against enterprise mail users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的关键跨站脚本缺陷使攻击者能够对企业邮件用户实施欺骗与钓鱼活动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server allows network-based remote code execution, targeting one of the most widely deployed enterprise messaging platforms.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，该漏洞针对业界最广泛部署的企业消息传递平台之一。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, risking sensitive document repositories.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中缺少身份验证，允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升，危及敏感文档存储库。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Exchange Server leads to local privilege escalation, exploiting trusted mail processing workflows.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，攻击者可利用受信任的邮件处理工作流。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution, threatening enterprise content management and collaboration systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不受信任的数据进行反序列化可启用远程代码执行，威胁企业内容管理与协作系统。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass using assumed-immutable data in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation over the network, undermining web application security models.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中利用假设不可变数据进行身份验证绕过，可实现网络权限提升，破坏 Web 应用程序安全模型。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authentication algorithm implementation in ASP.NET Core enables network-based privilege escalation, affecting modern web frameworks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中身份验证算法实现错误可导致基于网络的权限提升，影响现代 Web 框架。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Microsoft Edge allows information disclosure over the network, facilitating cross-site scripting and data theft attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的源验证错误可导致网络信息泄露，助长跨站脚本和数据窃取攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in JScript enables remote code execution over the network, impacting legacy script execution environments.
items.reason_zh: JScript 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，影响遗留脚本执行环境。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in .NET Framework allows network-based privilege escalation, affecting a wide range of enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中存在授权错误，可导致基于网络的权限提升，影响广泛的企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Copilot Chat (Edge) enables remote code execution, directly compromising browser-based AI assistant interactions.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Chat (Edge) 中的命令注入漏洞可实现远程代码执行，直接危及基于浏览器的 AI 助手交互功能。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows network-based privilege escalation, facilitating session hijacking and malicious content delivery.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，助长会话劫持和恶意内容投放。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft Copilot enables remote information disclosure, undermining trust in cloud-integrated web applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Copilot 中的命令注入漏洞可导致远程信息泄露，削弱对云集成 Web 应用程序的信任。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited per CISA KEV, this SharePoint code injection flaw allows network-based code execution, posing severe risks to web collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 根据 CISA KEV 记录正被积极利用，此 SharePoint 代码注入缺陷允许基于网络的代码执行，对 Web 协作平台构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables network-based privilege escalation by forcing internal server requests, bypassing perimeter defenses.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可通过强制内部服务器请求实现基于网络的权限提升，从而绕过边界防御。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows network-based code execution, exploiting weak input handling in web application frameworks.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不受信任的数据进行反序列化可实现基于网络的代码执行，利用 Web 应用框架中输入处理的弱点。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server enables network-based code execution, threatening critical email infrastructure and user communications.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，威胁关键电子邮件基础设施和用户通信。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file type upload in WordPress Super Forms plugin enables remote code execution by bypassing validation checks, widely affecting self-hosted WordPress deployments.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Super Forms 插件中存在无限制的文件类型上传漏洞，通过绕过验证检查实现远程代码执行，广泛影响自托管 WordPress 部署。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows remote code execution, posing significant risks to enterprise collaboration and document management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中对不受信任的数据进行反序列化可实现远程代码执行，对企业协作和文档管理平台构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in SharePoint enables privilege escalation, allowing attackers to bypass security controls and access sensitive organizational data and workflows.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中存在身份验证不当漏洞，可导致权限提升，使攻击者能够绕过安全控制并访问敏感的组织数据和业务流程。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection in Uncanny Automator WordPress plugin permits authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, leveraging insecure deserialization practices common in CMS extensions.
items.reason_zh: Uncanny Automator WordPress 插件中存在 PHP 对象注入漏洞，允许经过身份验证的攻击者执行任意代码，利用了 CMS 扩展中常见的不安全反序列化实践。

items.reason_en: Attacker-controlled sort parameters in JHipster-generated Spring WebFlux applications can trigger SQL injection or query manipulation, exposing sensitive backend data.
items.reason_zh: JHipster 生成的 Spring WebFlux 应用中，由攻击者控制的排序参数可能触发 SQL 注入或查询篡改，导致敏感后端数据暴露。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in WP Toolkit for cPanel allows local users to execute arbitrary code under other accounts, posing severe risks in shared hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: cPanel 的 WP Toolkit 中存在参数注入漏洞，允许本地用户在其他账户下执行任意代码，在共享主机环境中构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Portable ZIP import functionality in BookStack allows PHP polyglot uploads that bypass image validation, resulting in remote code execution for users with import permissions.
items.reason_zh: BookStack 的可移植 ZIP 导入功能允许上传绕过图像验证的 PHP 多态文件，导致具备导入权限的用户可执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Plugin handling in Budibase executes unsandboxed JavaScript via eval(), granting authenticated administrators full remote code execution capabilities on the host server.
items.reason_zh: Budibase 的插件处理机制通过 eval() 执行未沙箱化的 JavaScript，赋予已认证管理员在主服务器上完全执行远程代码的能力。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Budibase webhook automations allows attackers to execute arbitrary database queries using builder credentials, risking full data exfiltration or manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Budibase Webhook 自动化中存在无需认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者使用构建器凭据执行任意数据库查询，可能导致完整数据外泄或篡改。

items.reason_en: Grav CMS blueprint dynamic data passes unvalidated callable strings directly to call_user_func_array(), enabling remote code execution without authentication.
items.reason_zh: Grav CMS 蓝图动态数据将未经验证的可调用字符串直接传递给 call_user_func_array()，从而实现无需认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Better-auth SCIM plugin fails to reject duplicate provider IDs during token issuance, allowing complete authentication bypass and unauthorized account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Better-auth SCIM 插件在令牌签发期间未能拒绝重复的提供商 ID，导致完整的身份验证绕过和未授权账户接管。

items.reason_en: Grav CMS lacks required security@: admin.super restrictions on group blueprints, allowing delegated administrators to escalate privileges to super-admin level.
items.reason_zh: Grav CMS 未在组蓝图中实施所需的 security@: admin.super 限制，允许委派管理员将权限提升至超级管理员级别。

items.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated RCE via Python code execution in the crawl endpoint hooks parameter using allowed builtins.
items.reason_zh: 通过在爬取端点的 hooks 参数中使用允许的内置函数执行 Python 代码，引发关键的无需认证远程代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild; CORS misconfiguration combined with token handling enables account takeover and RCE.
items.reason_zh: 已在真实环境中被积极利用；CORS 配置错误与令牌处理结合，可导致账户接管和远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critically exploited vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via the API validation endpoint.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已被严重利用，允许攻击者通过 API 验证端点执行无需认证的远程代码。

items.reason_en: Path normalization flaws in whitelist logic allow crafted requests to bypass authentication and access protected APIs.
items.reason_zh: 白名单逻辑中的路径规范化缺陷允许构造的请求绕过身份验证并访问受保护的API。

items.reason_en: Missing file extension validation permits uploading executable PHP scripts, leading to immediate remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 缺少文件扩展名验证允许上传可执行的PHP脚本，导致立即远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Open proxy configuration enables unauthenticated SSRF attacks, exposing internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 开放代理配置使得未认证的SSRF攻击成为可能，暴露内部服务和云元数据端点。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited vulnerability in SP Page Builder for Joomla allows unauthenticated file uploads leading to arbitrary PHP code execution.
items.reason_zh: Joomla的SP Page Builder中存在被主动利用的漏洞，允许未认证的文件上传，从而导致任意PHP代码执行。

items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中缺失授权检查机制，允许基于网络的代码执行，严重影响企业协作平台与文档管理系统的安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics NAV leads to remote code execution, posing a significant risk to enterprise business applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics NAV 中对不受信任数据进行反序列化操作可导致远程代码执行，对企业级业务应用构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_en: Improper resource naming restrictions in GitHub Copilot allow local code execution, raising significant security concerns for AI-assisted development environments.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 中资源命名限制机制存在缺陷，允许本地代码执行，给 AI 辅助开发环境带来严重的安全隐患。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.6 incomplete comparison in Visual Studio Code allows network security feature bypass, impacting developer workflows and CI/CD pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中存在 CVSS 9.6 评分比较逻辑不完整的问题，可导致网络安全功能被绕过，影响开发者工作流及 CI/CD 流水线安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.6 improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator enables local privilege escalation, undermining the reliability of multi-factor authentication systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 中存在 CVSS 8.6 评分的身份验证缺陷，可导致本地权限提升，严重削弱多因素认证系统的可靠性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 command injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot exposes business chat data to unauthorized network actors, highlighting emerging risks in AI-integrated applications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot 中存在 CVSS 7.4 评分的命令注入漏洞，致使业务聊天数据向未授权网络实体暴露，凸显了 AI 集成应用的新兴安全风险。

items.reason_en: Secure Boot bypass in Windows allows unauthorized bootloader execution, undermining hardware-rooted trust mechanisms and firmware security.
items.reason_zh: Windows 系统中存在 Secure Boot 绕过漏洞，允许执行未授权的引导加载程序，破坏了基于硬件的信任机制及固件安全性。

items.reason_en: SSTP use-after-free enables local privilege escalation, affecting VPN tunnel establishment and remote access security architectures.
items.reason_zh: SSTP释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响VPN隧道建立及远程访问安全架构。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Paint allows remote code execution via malicious image files, impacting multimedia processing and rendering engines.
items.reason_zh: Windows Paint中的堆溢出漏洞允许通过恶意图像文件实现远程代码执行，影响多媒体处理与渲染引擎。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Microsoft Partner Center enables unauthenticated information disclosure, compromising vendor management and billing portals.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center中的授权绕过漏洞可导致未认证信息泄露，危及供应商管理与计费门户。

items.reason_en: Link following flaw in Windows Shell enables remote spoofing attacks, tricking users into executing malicious shortcuts or payloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell中的链接跟随缺陷可引发远程欺骗攻击，诱骗用户执行恶意快捷方式或有效载荷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Hyper-V enables local privilege escalation, directly impacting virtualization host security and guest isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接影响虚拟化主机安全与客户机隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Missing cryptographic step in Windows CryptoAPI allows local tampering, weakening foundational system integrity and authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows CryptoAPI中缺失加密步骤可导致本地篡改，削弱基础系统完整性与身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Elevation of privilege in Microsoft Defender's Malware Protection Engine (ShieldBreak) allows attackers to bypass endpoint security controls locally.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender恶意软件保护引擎（ShieldBreak）中的权限提升漏洞允许攻击者在本地绕过终端安全控制。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in .NET permits local privilege escalation, affecting a wide range of enterprise applications relying on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的整数溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响大量依赖该框架的企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Untrusted control sphere inclusion in VS Code Python extension allows local security feature bypass, impacting developer workflow integrity.
items.reason_zh: VS Code Python扩展中引入不受信任的控制域可导致本地安全功能绕过，影响开发者工作流的完整性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in PowerShell enables local code execution, compromising automation scripts and administrative task execution.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell中的命令注入漏洞可导致本地代码执行，破坏自动化脚本与管理员任务的执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code enables remote code execution over the network, impacting developer workstations and automated CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中缺失授权漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，影响开发者工作站与自动化CI/CD流水线。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in PowerShell Core allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network, affecting enterprise automation and scripting workflows.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell Core中的服务端请求伪造漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的信息泄露，影响企业自动化与脚本工作流。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Splunk Enterprise via Linux package upgrades grants root access to attackers who can run commands under the Splunk service account.
items.reason_zh: 通过Linux包升级可在Splunk Enterprise中实现本地权限提升，使攻击者获得root权限，并能以Splunk服务账户身份运行命令。

items.reason_en: Missing content-type validation in Pydantic AI framework exposes developers to cross-origin attacks via browser-compatible endpoints, impacting generative AI application security.
items.reason_zh: Pydantic AI框架中缺失Content-Type验证会使开发者面临通过兼容浏览器端点进行跨域攻击的风险，影响生成式AI应用安全。

items.reason_en: Insecure git directory validation in GitPython allows attackers to impersonate repository paths and execute arbitrary code via malicious pre-commit hooks during standard repo operations.
items.reason_zh: GitPython中不安全的git目录验证允许攻击者伪装仓库路径，并在标准仓库操作中通过恶意pre-commit钩子执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Concurrency slot retention in Pydantic AI frameworks can cause resource exhaustion in high-throughput generative AI workflows, impacting application stability and scalability.
items.reason_zh: Pydantic AI框架中的并发槽位保留问题可能导致高吞吐量生成式AI工作流出现资源耗尽，影响应用的稳定性与可扩展性。

items.reason_en: NLTK pickle loaders trust entire module namespaces instead of specific safe callables, allowing crafted malicious payloads to invoke dangerous functions and trigger remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: NLTK pickle加载器信任整个模块命名空间而非特定安全调用对象，使得精心构造的恶意有效载荷能够调用危险函数并触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: GitPython corrupts multi-line git-config values during serialization, enabling command injection by forging live git directives like core.hooksPath from embedded newlines.
items.reason_zh: GitPython在序列化期间会损坏多行git-config值，攻击者可利用嵌入的换行符伪造如core.hooksPath等实时git指令，从而实现命令注入。

items.reason_en: Hugging Face sentence-transformers import_module_class helper contains a logic flaw that bypasses guard conditions, allowing attackers to load and execute arbitrary Python modules.
items.reason_zh: Hugging Face sentence-transformers的import_module_class辅助函数存在逻辑缺陷，可绕过守卫条件，允许攻击者加载并执行任意Python模块。

items.reason_en: Ray WebDataset reader unconditionally invokes _default_decoder() on malicious tar archives, resulting in unsafe deserialization and remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Ray WebDataset读取器会对恶意tar归档文件无条件调用_default_decoder()，导致不安全的反序列化与远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Allows arbitrary Python code execution by manipulating the field_type parameter passed to eval() in the AI framework.
items.reason_zh: 通过操纵传递给AI框架中eval()函数的field_type参数，可执行任意Python代码。

items.reason_en: User-controlled YAML and CLI values are concatenated into command strings without proper quoting, leading to OS command injection.
items.reason_zh: 用户可控的YAML和CLI值未经适当引号处理直接拼接为命令字符串，导致操作系统命令注入。

items.reason_en: Digest qop=auth-int causes mutual-authentication verification to be skipped, significantly weakening TLS handshake security.
items.reason_zh: Digest qop=auth-int会导致双向身份验证验证被跳过，显著削弱TLS握手安全性。

items.reason_en: Command-line argument handling passes unsanitized input directly to eval(), enabling arbitrary Python code execution.
items.reason_zh: 命令行参数处理将未过滤的输入直接传递给eval()，从而允许执行任意Python代码。

items.reason_en: Triggers unexpected authenticated registry accesses on behalf of victims, enabling resource exhaustion and local path traversal.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞会代表受害者触发意外的已认证注册表访问，导致资源耗尽与本地路径遍历。

items.reason_en: Unbounded WebSocket decompression in AsyncHttpClient allows resource exhaustion attacks against Java applications processing compressed frames.
items.reason_zh: AsyncHttpClient中无限制的WebSocket解压缩漏洞可对处理压缩帧的Java应用程序发起资源耗尽攻击。

items.reason_en: Class name caching flaw in Apache Commons BCEL permits symbolic name substitution attacks that can bypass bytecode verification and security checks.
items.reason_zh: Apache Commons BCEL中的类名缓存缺陷允许进行符号名称替换攻击，从而绕过字节码验证与安全检查。
